Sweetcorn & Lemongrass Soup
A delicate, velvety sweetcorn soup infused with fragrant lemongrass, fresh ginger and subtle Asian seasonings.
Miso-Maple Glazed Aubergine
Tender roasted aubergine glazed with savoury miso and maple syrup, offering a beautiful balance of sweetness and umami.
Contains: soya.
Kung Pao Tofu
Golden tofu tossed with colourful peppers, roasted peanuts and a mildly spiced, tangy Asian sauce, finished with toasted sesame seeds.
Contains: soya, peanuts and sesame.
Miso-Roasted Broccoli with Cashew Nuts
Roasted broccoli florets coated in a savoury miso glaze, finished with golden toasted cashew nuts.
Contains: soya and nuts.
Fragrant Jasmine Rice
Light, fluffy jasmine rice gently steamed to perfection, offering a delicate floral aroma and a beautiful accompaniment to Asian-inspired dishes.
Coconut Chia Pudding with Fruit Compote, Fresh Strawberries and Roasted Coconut Chips
Silky coconut chia pudding layered with seasonal fruit compote, topped with fresh strawberries and crisp roasted coconut chips.



Roasted Butternut Squash Soup
A smooth, velvety soup of roasted butternut squash, gently infused with warming spices and finished with a delicate swirl of cream.
Contains: dairy.
Paneer Hara Bhara Kebab
Delicate pan-seared kebabs made with fresh spinach, green vegetables, aromatic Indian spices and soft paneer, served with a refreshing mint and coriander chutney.
Contains: dairy.
Bean Sprout Salad
A vibrant combination of tender bean sprouts, crisp seasonal vegetables and fresh herbs, tossed in a light citrus dressing.
Vegetable Masala Khichdi with Dahi Kadhi
Comforting basmati rice and yellow moong lentils simmered with seasonal vegetables and warming spices, accompanied by a silky yoghurt and gram-flour kadhi.
Contains: dairy.
Mango Mousse with Roasted Almond Flakes and Cardamom Dust
A light, creamy mango mousse crowned with golden roasted almond flakes and a delicate dusting of fragrant cardamom.
Contains: dairy and nuts.

Friday – Indian Dinner
Vegetable Pakora with Mint Chutney
Crisp golden fritters of seasonal vegetables in a delicately spiced gram-flour batter, served with fresh mint and coriander chutney.
Paneer Butter Masala
Soft cubes of paneer simmered in a luxurious, creamy tomato sauce, delicately flavoured with traditional Indian spices.
Contains: dairy and nuts if prepared with cashew paste.
Dal Makhani
Slow-cooked whole black lentils enriched with butter, cream and warming spices for a beautifully smooth, comforting finish.
Contains: dairy.
Zafrani polau 
Fragrant basmati rice delicately infused with saffron and whole aromatic spices, finished with golden toasted nuts.
Contains: nuts and dairy if finished with ghee.
Traditional Rice Kheer
A classic Indian rice pudding gently simmered in milk, delicately perfumed with cardamom and garnished with roasted nuts.
Contains: dairy and nuts.
Mild Mexican Bean Soup
A comforting blend of tender mixed beans, tomatoes, sweetcorn and seasonal vegetables, gently simmered with cumin, smoked paprika and mild Mexican spices.
Smoked Paprika Roasted Potatoes
Golden roasted potatoes seasoned with smoked paprika, fragrant herbs and extra virgin olive oil, offering a delicate smoky flavour and crispy finish.
Seasoned Mixed Leaf Salad
A refreshing selection of tender seasonal salad leaves, crisp vegetables and fresh herbs, lightly tossed in a zesty citrus vinaigrette.
Asparagus, Tofu & Cheddar Quesadillas
Warm, golden tortillas filled with tender asparagus, seasoned tofu and melted mature cheddar cheese, lightly toasted until perfectly crisp.
Contains: gluten, soya and dairy.
Mexican Garden Salad
A colourful combination of mixed beans, sweetcorn, ripe tomatoes, cucumber and peppers, tossed with fresh coriander and a vibrant lime dressing.
Zesty Lime Cheesecake
A smooth, creamy cheesecake infused with fresh lime zest, resting on a delicate buttery biscuit base and finished with a refreshing citrus glaze.
Contains: gluten and dairy.
